metadata.title: COBO L2 - Windows 11 Deployment & Hardening Profile

props.name: implements-sspp
props.remarks: Implements the COBO L2 Enhanced-Assurance Managed Endpoint SSPP for Windows 11.

props.name: extends-implementation
props.remarks: COBO L2 Windows profile is a strict delta over the COBO L1 Windows 11 implementation.

metadata.remarks: This component defines additional Windows 11 hardening and enforcement requirements required to achieve COBO L2 enhanced endpoint assurance. It inherits all COBO L1 Windows controls and selectively enforces additional CIS Level 2 recommendations with stricter enforcement expectations.

components.title: Enhanced Authentication and Credential Assurance
components.description: Additional authentication and credential protection requirements beyond COBO L1.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Stronger password and credential protections enforced beyond baseline.
Credential Guard enabled where hardware supports it.
Enhanced credential management protections.

components.title: Enhanced Application Control
components.description: Expanded application execution restrictions and abuse prevention.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Expanded Attack Surface Reduction rules enforced, including script abuse protections.
Stricter least functionality enforcement for executable content.

components.title: Stricter Health and Compliance Enforcement
components.description: Reduced tolerance for configuration drift and delayed remediation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Stricter device health checks and compliance reporting.
More frequent and rigorous posture assessments.

components.title: Enhanced Threat Detection and Local Containment
components.description: Lower tolerance for active threats and faster isolation actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Aggressive malware blocking and automatic containment enabled.
Immediate containment required for detected endpoint threats.

components.title: Bluetooth Disabled or Constrained (COBO L2)
components.description: Implements CIS Windows 11 Bluetooth attack-surface controls for COBO L2 endpoints using either full Bluetooth disablement or a set of pre-approved, CDX-testable mitigating controls when Bluetooth audio is required.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Bluetooth Audio Gateway Service (BTAGService) is either fully disabled OR constrained using institutionally approved, CDX-testable mitigating controls.
Bluetooth Support Service (bthserv) is either fully disabled OR constrained using institutionally approved, CDX-testable mitigating controls.
Satisfied through Intune or Windows-native enforcement equivalent to CIS Windows 11 Enterprise control intent.
Satisfied through Intune or Windows-native enforcement equivalent to CIS Windows 11 Enterprise control intent.
Bluetooth functionality is limited to approved use cases and unnecessary services are disabled.
Endpoint behavior is monitored for Bluetooth-related abuse or anomalous activity.
Wireless pairing, advertising, and signaling mechanisms are protected to prevent unauthorized association.

components.title: Approved Bluetooth Audio-Only Mitigating Controls
components.description: Pre-approved configuration set allowing encrypted Bluetooth audio while blocking all other Bluetooth functionality.

implemented-requirements.remarks: ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowPrepairing = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowTempDisableSSP = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowFileTransfer = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowRFCOMM = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowPAN = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowHIDPairing = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowDiscoverability = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowAdvertising = 0
./Device/Vendor/MSFT/PolicyManager/Connectivity/Bluetooth/AllowGATTServer = 0
Bluetooth Audio Gateway Service set to Disabled OR constrained to prevent user activation.
Bluetooth Support Service set to Disabled OR constrained to prevent pairing and discovery.
Bluetooth discoverability disabled via policy.
Bluetooth file transfer disabled via policy.

components.remarks: Bluetooth audio services may remain enabled ONLY when the full mitigation set is enforced. Any deviation renders the endpoint non-compliant with COBO L2.

CIS Bluetooth controls are satisfied for COBO L2 endpoints when Bluetooth is either fully disabled or constrained using the approved mitigation set. Endpoints that do not meet either condition MUST NOT be classified as COBO L2. Workflows requiring zero wireless attack surface MUST use DAW-class endpoints.

components.title: Documented CIS Level 2 Deviations
components.description: Explicitly justified deviations from CIS Level 2 recommendations.
components.remarks: All CIS Level 2 controls not enforced at the COBO L2 tier MUST be documented with rationale, compensating controls, and approval.
